qr_generated.description: User generated a QR code from the payment form

properties.has_branding: true if colors or center text differ from defaults
properties.has_logo: true if a logo is set

format_selected.description: User switched the QR format (BySquare / EPC / SPAYD)

optional_field_toggled.description: User toggled an optional payment field on/off via the per-format Fields menu

properties.enabled: true if the field was shown, false if hidden

format_hint_accepted.description: User clicked the soft IBAN/format mismatch hint to switch format (hint never auto-switches; no *_shown counterpart by convention - no useEffect tracking)

form_validation_failed.description: Submit blocked by client-side validation - measures the EPC selection->generation drop-off (mandatory recipient name hypothesis)

properties.fields: comma-joined sorted field names that failed validation

api_qr_generated.description: QR code generated via the REST API

qr_downloaded.description: User downloaded the generated QR code as PNG. Fired from both home preview and studio.

qr_copied.description: User copied the QR code image to clipboard at the picked size

qr_shared.description: User used the native Web Share API to share the QR code at the picked size

share_link_copied.description: User copied the shareable payment link from the share dialog

shared_qr_downloaded.description: Recipient downloaded the QR code from the shared payment page

shared_qr_copied.description: Recipient copied the QR code from the shared payment page

logo_uploaded.description: User uploaded a custom logo for the QR code center

qr_customizer_applied.description: User applied customizer changes from the home sheet

customizer_reset.description: User reset customizer settings to defaults

customizer_template_saved.description: User saved current customizer config as a reusable template

customizer_template_loaded.description: User loaded a previously saved customizer template

customizer_template_deleted.description: User deleted a saved customizer template

qr_dot_style_changed.description: User changed the QR code dot style

customizer_preset_applied.description: User applied a starter preset (Classic / Bold / Sunset / Framed) from the home sheet or studio

customizer_nudge_clicked.description: User clicked the 'Add your logo' nudge to open the customizer sheet

history_entry_named.description: User assigned a custom name to a payment history entry

history_entry_unnamed.description: User removed the custom name from a history entry

history_item_selected.description: User loaded a previous payment from history into the form

bulk_csv_uploaded.description: User uploaded a CSV file for bulk QR generation

bulk_sample_csv_downloaded.description: User downloaded the sample CSV template

bulk_qr_generated.description: Bulk QR codes were generated from uploaded CSV

bulk_exported_zip.description: User exported bulk QR codes as a ZIP archive

bulk_exported_pdf.description: User exported bulk QR codes as a PDF document

bulk_printed.description: User printed bulk QR codes via browser print dialog

feature_request_opened.description: User opened the feature request / feedback dialog

feature_request_submitted.description: User successfully submitted a feature request

consent_banner_dismissed.description: User dismissed the cookie/analytics consent banner

announcement_changelog_clicked.description: User clicked the 'Read changelog' link in the announcement banner
